mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4/2D6 and CYP2D6 respectively, with potential for increased tolterodine exposure; primaquine may inhibit CYP metabolism and both drugs have anticholinergic/antimuscarinic properties that could be additive.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if needed; assess for QT prolongation risk as both agents have some cardiac effects.
